items.title: How Investors Are Reacting To Prologis (PLD) Chicago Expansion And Fresh Dividend Declaration
items.summary: Earlier this month, Prologis, Inc. declared regular quarterly cash dividends of US$1.07 per common share and US$1.0675 per 8.54% Series Q preferred share, both payable on September 30, 2026, to stockholders of record on September 16, 2026. Around the same time, Prologis moved to acquire 69 acres in Minooka for a planned 1 million square foot Chicago-area logistics development, underscoring its continued build-out of large-scale industrial capacity in a key US distribution market.
